name: Antonino Dolce
original_name: アントニーノ・ドルチェ
source:
A veteran investigator for Europol, an organization that provides assistance between EU agencies. 
Confident and prideful in his investigative skills that rely on footwork and intuition, cultivated during his time with the Italian police force, he relentlessly pursues the main characters to corner them.

His subordinate, Noel, refers to him as "Police Inspector," his role in his previous workplace.

Hometown: Italy
